subject.title: fix(music): bound stalled generated audio download body reads

question: Should generated-music `timeoutMs` become an operation-wide deadline that can abort a slow but continuously progressing audio body after headers arrive?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and proven against a real loopback stream, but the intended compatibility contract for slow successful generated-audio downloads is a product/runtime policy choice rather than a defect that can be resolved automatically.

options.title: Adopt operation-wide timeout
options.body: Accept `timeoutMs` as the full generated-music download budget and merge after refreshed exact-head CI confirms the branch.

options.title: Preserve chunk-idle semantics
options.body: Keep the current behavior for continuously progressing bodies and narrow this PR to an explicit idle-timeout or caller-approved budget path.

recommendation.title: Adopt operation-wide timeout
recommendation.body: Accept `timeoutMs` as the full generated-music download budget and merge after refreshed exact-head CI confirms the branch.
